# Notebook 示例

顶部运行全部 R 代码块，⌘↩运行当前块。结果显示在 Visual 中；R 会话状态位于右侧，Rscript 路径在软件设置中选择。

## 数据与普通输出

```{r}
#| label: data-example
# 可修改下面的数值，再运行此块
notebook_example_runs <- if (exists("notebook_example_runs")) notebook_example_runs + 1L else 1L
dat <- data.frame(
  group = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), 2),
  sex = rep(c("男", "女"), each = 3),
  value = c(22, 28, 18, 19, 25, 21)
)
dat
```

## kable 表格

```{r}
#| label: kable-example
knitr::kable(dat, caption = "分组数据")
```

## flextable 表格

```{r}
#| label: flextable-example
ft <- flextable::flextable(dat)
ft <- flextable::theme_vanilla(ft)
flextable::bold(ft, part = "header")
```

## ggplot 图形

```{r}
#| label: ggplot-example
ggplot2::ggplot(dat, ggplot2::aes(x = group, y = value, fill = sex)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "分组对比", x = "组别", y = "数值", fill = "性别") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

## 流程图

```mermaid
flowchart LR
A[编辑代码] --> B[运行 R]
B --> C[查看结果]
```
